spans.s:
फुत्, indecl.
 1. The expression of disregard.
 2. Imitative sound, implying the boiling of water, etc. (see कृ, and cf. फूत्).

फूत् = फुत्,
 1. Imitative sound of blowing, Böhtl. Ind.
. Crying aloud, expression of indignation, anger, Pañc. 35, 11; 82, 18; 193, 11; Vetālap. xviii. MS. (see कृ).

फुत्-कार,
 I. adj. Disdainful, arrogant.
 II. m. The sound of bubbling (see फूत्कार).
फूत्कर्तुमनस्, i. e. फूत्-कर्तुम्-मनस्, adj. Intending to cry aloud, to rage, Pañc. 40, 19.
